description: Empiric therapy for sepsis when the source is unknown. Mapped from DKR sepsis_unknown_origin.json (id sepsis_of_unknown_origin); TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02. Steward bacteremia.json mentions sepsis / septic shock but is not this unknown-source pathway (DKR rank 1 is cefepime + metronidazole + vancomycin).

one_time_doses.dose_note: 5mg/kg (IBW) x 1 dose, or 2mg/kg (IBW) if HD or CrCl <20
one_time_doses.note: TODO: tobramycin is named in DKR but has no monograph in guidelines/drugs/

regimens.reasoning: Cefepime plus metronidazole plus vancomycin first-line for sepsis of unknown origin (TUH 2025-04-02 rank 1)
regimens.evidence: TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02
regimens.note: One-time tobramycin 5mg/kg IBW (2mg/kg if HD or CrCl <20) if septic shock (TODO: tobramycin not in guidelines/drugs/).

regimens.reasoning: Same cefepime-based regimen is listed for mild PCN allergy (rash)
regimens.note: One-time tobramycin if septic shock (TODO: tobramycin not in guidelines/drugs/).
